files.title: Image URLs
files.description: Direct links to the images. Accepted: HEIC/HEIF, AVIF, WebP, PNG, JPG, TIFF, GIF, SVG.

format.title: Output format
format.description: File type of the converted images.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: 1–100. For PNG below 100 the image is palette-quantized (much smaller, like TinyPNG).

width.title: Max width (px)
width.description: Leave empty to keep the original size.

height.title: Max height (px)
height.description: Leave empty to keep the original size.

fit.title: Fit
fit.description: inside = keep aspect ratio within the box. cover = fill the box and crop. contain = fit and pad with the background colour. fill = stretch.

allowUpscale.title: Allow upscaling
allowUpscale.description: By default smaller images are never enlarged.

background.title: Background colour
background.description: Used when flattening transparency to JPG and for 'contain' padding.

lossless.title: Lossless
lossless.description: Lossless WebP/AVIF, full-colour PNG, LZW TIFF.

keepMetadata.title: Keep metadata (EXIF, GPS, ICC)
keepMetadata.description: Off by default: location and camera data are removed.

maxFileSizeMb.title: Max file size (MB)
maxFileSizeMb.description: Larger files are skipped with an error (not charged).
